meta.title: DSH-Bot Personal Agents
meta.description: Your personal agent workspace for DeepSeek Harness. Create multiple personal agents, each with its own persona, long-term memory, tools and skills, working alongside you over time.

tools.bot_manage.approval.create: Create Bot {id} named {name} and register its preset?
tools.bot_manage.approval.update: Update Bot {id}? Changed top-level fields: {fields}. New and cold-restored sessions use the updated configuration; live sessions keep their current configuration.{selfWarning}
tools.bot_manage.approval.delete: Delete Bot {id} and its preset? {memoryWarning} Session history remains, but cannot resume until this Bot id exists again.{selfWarning}
tools.bot_manage.approval.deleteMemories: WARNING: deleteMemories=true — DELETE ALL {count} MEMORIES currently belonging to this Bot (counted before approval).
tools.bot_manage.approval.selfUpdate: WARNING: this modifies the CURRENT BOT ITSELF. Changes to tools.deny can remove tool restrictions for future sessions. This live Agent keeps its existing restrictions.
tools.bot_manage.approval.selfDelete: WARNING: this deletes the CURRENT BOT ITSELF. This live Agent keeps its existing restrictions; new sessions and cold restoration will be unavailable without this Bot preset.
tools.bot_delegate.description: Delegate a task to a Bot using native spawn after approval. Only task is sent, without parent history. Returns childId and accepted status, not completion. Native settlement reports to this exact live parent (steers if busy). No cold-parent redelivery. Child actions requiring approval are denied. Background sessions and notice turns cannot delegate. Use bot_message to ask the teammate in their own main conversation.
tools.bot_delegate.approval:
Delegate to {target} as a native child in the current working directory. Only this task is sent: {task}
The child uses the target Bot preset and native delegated permissions; actions requiring approval are denied. The result goes to this live session and may steer it or start another model turn. No redelivery after parent replacement.
tools.bot_notify.description: Record a notification using an existing policy. External delivery needs native approval unless explicitly preapproved.
tools.bot_message.description: Exchange text with a teammate in their own main conversation. list: directory; send: to/content/mode (ask or notify), optional priority; reply: replyTo/content. Returns queued, never waits for peer. No nested run_code calls.
tools.bot_message.approval: {from} → {to}; {mode}, {priority}. Approve this thread and downstream read-only collaboration. Interrupt requests cancel the current task, keep queued inputs and cannot undo completed effects. Text: {content} Read-only downstream targets: {targets}.
